text:
So that you may sleep, my child,

the sunset burns no more:

nothing shines now but the dew,

nothing is whiter than my face.


So that you may sleep, my child,

the road has fallen silent:

no one moans except the river;

nothing exists except me.


The plain has drowned in mist.

The blue sigh has drawn in.

Stillness has come to rest,

like a hand upon the world.


I did not rock only

my child inside my song:

the cradle's back-and-forth

was lulling Earth to sleep…

translation.title: Night
translation.editorial_note: The translation follows the lullaby's narrowing hush and then restores its cosmic reach in the final cradle motion.
